mapper.select: SELECT a.opr01_create_id AS create_id , a.opr01_title AS title , a.opr01_year AS year , f_cdnm('TermCodeOpr', a.opr01_term_cd, a.opr01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS term_name , f_emp_kor_nm(b.emp00_person_id) AS kor_name , b.emp00_pos_nm AS pos_name , a.opr01_start_date AS start_date FROM opr01_create a INNER JOIN emp00_trans_info b ON a.opr01_company_id = b.emp00_company_id AND a.opr01_create_emp_id = b.emp00_person_id WHERE b.emp00_all_title = 0 AND a.opr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND f_trunc(f_sysdate()) BETWEEN b.emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(b.emp00_close_date, '9999.12.31') AND a.opr01_title || f_emp_kor_nm(b.emp00_person_id) LIKE #{title} AND a.opr01_year LIKE #{year} ORDER BY a.opr01_create_id DESC

SELECT a.opr02_fund_id AS fund_id , a.opr02_reg_fund_id AS reg_fund_id , b.fnd00_fund_cd AS fund_code , b.fnd00_fund_nm AS fund_name , f_cdnm('FundTypeCode', b.fnd00_fund_type_cd, b.fnd00_company_id, b.fnd00_work_date) AS fund_type_name , f_emp_kor_nm(c.emp00_person_id) AS emp_name1 , b.fnd00_start_date AS start_date , CASE b.fnd00_public_yn WHEN 'true' THEN '공모' ELSE '사모' END AS public_name , f_org_nm(b.fnd00_org_code_id, b.fnd00_work_date) AS org_code_name FROM opr02_fund a INNER JOIN fnd00_fund b ON a.opr02_reg_fund_id = b.fnd00_fund_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp00_trans_info c ON b.fnd00_emp1_id = c.emp00_person_id AND c.emp00_all_title = 0 AND b.fnd00_work_date BETWEEN c.emp00_trans_date AND c.emp00_close_date INNER JOIN fnd08_org_auth d ON a.opr02_reg_fund_id = d.fnd08_fund_code_id WHERE b.fnd00_work_date = f_max_workdate(a.opr02_reg_fund_id, f_trunc(f_sysdate())) AND d.fnd08_auth_yn = 'true' AND d.fnd08_org_code_id = #{orgId} AND b.fnd00_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.opr02_create_id = #{createId} ORDER BY b.fnd00_fund_cd
